composition.observation: Preparation stacks the large registered camera panel before the contextual Meet your hand guidance; calibration instead promotes the nearly full-width target plane before the smaller camera preview. The cream/brass/sea-green instrument treatment belongs to the inspected accepted mobile Homeport family while providing a denser task workspace. Desktop preparation presents a broad camera stage beside contextual guidance; calibration promotes a large registered target plane while retaining the smaller camera and instruction column. The inspected accepted desktop Homeport reference shares the same brand/account shell, cream serif hierarchy and sea-green/brass palette.

hierarchy.observation: The numbered Prepare / Calibrate / Check / Explore strip and serif task headings separate current stage from instructions. FIT_READY explicitly says Independent check required, and RESULTS only later says Independent check passed. The target-plane message and compact status repeat the outcome at the current scroll position. Desktop FIT_READY leaves measurements Not measured and explicitly requires five new targets; RESULTS then changes to Independent check passed with session metrics and a clear playground action. The target plane repeats the essential outcome separately from diagnostics.

typography.observation: Cream serif display headings remain distinct from muted sans-serif instructions and small monospaced instrument labels. Target numerals, progress text, camera recovery labels, and the two-line pause explanation are legible in the 390 by 844 PNGs. Small secondary captions are visibly subordinate; numeric font-size or contrast compliance is not inferred from pixels. At the supplied desktop geometry, large serif headings separate the task from sans-serif instructions and small instrument/metric captions. Numbered targets remain readable over the grid. No numeric font-size or contrast-compliance claim is inferred.

spacing.observation: Consistent side gutters, consistent rounded panels, and separated action rows keep the narrow layout orderly. Move demo hand to target / Pause fit together, with Retry / Cancel in a second row. Long pause and simulation disclosures wrap without collisions. Diagnostics and privacy remain separated below the primary task. Desktop target and guidance columns have clear gutters; primary actions and secondary retry/cancel rows stay separated. The current returned desktop link is below the header in all six byte-identical return screenshots. Mobile preparation remains a long scroll, while calibration gives the target and action rows priority.

controls.observation: Ordinary buttons expose pause/resume, retry, cancel, camera retry, and guided demo. Pointing mode choices show both a selected radio and explicit Recommended / Experimental labels. The tracking-condition select remains readable with a visible focus ring. The returned laboratory re-entry link is fully visible beneath the fixed header in every current mobile return raster. Desktop controls use consistent plain names and visible primary/secondary treatment. Relative movement is recommended; absolute pointing is experimental. Both mode paths expose pause, retry, recalibrate and a distinct next-stage check. Current return links are visible; successful actionability and keyboard re-entry receive supporting regression-test evidence rather than being inferred solely from pixels.

contrast.observation: Cream task text and brass primary controls stand out against dark sea-green panels; the double focus outline is conspicuous around the target stage, Resume button, and condition select. Amber targets and teal cursor marks remain distinguishable by shape and position as well as color. Grid and perimeter marks are deliberately subtle. This is a rendered legibility judgment, not a measured WCAG ratio claim. Desktop cream text, brass actions/targets and mint tracking cues are visibly distinct from the dark surfaces. Focus outlines stand out on the plane, Resume and tracking-condition select. The faint grid stays subordinate. This is a rendered legibility judgment with no independently measured WCAG ratios.

consistency.observation: Both motion modes retain the same header, four-stage strip, rounded instrument frame, highlighted status, and ordinary action pattern. Absolute states retain Absolute estimate / Experimental absolute pointing; relative states consistently use Relative movement / Relative cursor control. Current return screenshots are byte-identical across all six mobile journey/motion contexts. Desktop NORMAL and REDUCED preserve stage names, control ordering, simulation labels and distinct pointing/cursor claims. All six current desktop returns share the same raster with a readable laboratory link, matching the repaired mobile return outcome.

states.observation: The inspected current mobile evidence covers welcome, honest simulated tracking, training, paused progress, fit ready, independent validation, results, playground, second-hand context, detected-ineligible guidance, separate relative setup/check/results, unavailable camera, and returned destination. Detected-ineligible switches the prominent guidance to Move your hand slightly toward the center; successful setup alone still requires an independent check. Desktop media also covers all 15 states. It visibly separates 1 detected, Hand framed and Point recognized; the edge condition retains detection but changes framing guidance and removes the actionable pointer. Two-hand context exposes active-hand choices. Setup, held-out check, pass and practice remain distinct.

responsive.observation: At 390 by 844, preparation and calibration use a coherent single column, mode cards and controls wrap within the viewport, and the target remains large enough to inspect. The fixed header leaves the current returned re-entry text fully below its lower edge, preserving the repaired destination navigation. Sticky guidance can occupy the top of a scrolled target panel while the current condition select remains in view. No horizontal clipping of primary controls is visible in the supplied geometry. Desktop keeps a broad target beside a compact preview/guidance column without visible primary-control clipping. The current desktop return and mobile return remain below their respective persistent headers. The supplied viewports support this bounded judgment rather than an exhaustive device matrix.

keyboard.observation: Rendered evidence shows conventional focus progression: the welcome task heading receives a visible outline, Pause becomes a focused Resume control, the diagnostics disclosure can be focused, target movement controls remain focused as collection advances, and the tracking-condition select retains focus after its value changes. The recordings demonstrate progress using these conventional controls. Pixels do not establish every key event, full tab order, or screen-reader semantics. Desktop actual media shows a focused Resume button and a tracking-condition select whose value changes while focus stays visible. The unchanged return regression source explicitly follows keyboard navigation to Device connections, checks untouched settled geometry/hit testing, then tabs to and activates re-entry. The independently recorded exact-candidate hosted full-file pass supports that path; its actual case count is unavailable and complete traversal is not claimed.

focus.observation: A high-visibility cream/brass double outline marks the welcome heading, target plane, Resume button, diagnostics disclosure, and selected condition control at the relevant captures. The reduced relative recording at 23.32 seconds visibly focuses Device connections immediately before return. At the destination the re-entry link is unobscured, although these captures do not independently show focus subsequently moved onto that destination link. Desktop entry heading, target plane, Resume and condition select have strong outlines in current PNGs. The new rendered destination link is unobscured; media does not directly show subsequent focus onto it. The supporting exact-candidate full-file regression result covers a declaration that tabs to and activates that link after measuring the untouched landing, without independently proving every focused pixel.

feedback.observation: Training and independent check show saved target counts, collection percentages, Find a comfortable hold / Hold here collecting guidance, and visible arc/progress changes. Pausing replaces the instruction with saved-progress reassurance and Resume. Camera failure exposes The camera could not start plus retry/demo. Settled demo tracking clearly separates detected count, framing, and point recognition, with the simulated-hand disclosure adjacent. Desktop recordings show target numbers advancing, saved counts and collection percentages updating, pause preserving progress, and a required independent check before success. Current capture telemetry ranges from 841.465015 to 869.265622 ms across 12 contexts against the 5000 ms budget; it supports software UI feedback only and was not independently retimed from sampled frames.

motion.observation: Meaningful frames from all six current recordings show entry, acquisition/demo readiness, setup/check progress or camera failure, and return. Both motion modes retain the same useful state outcomes. Normal return shows a short compositing transition at 39.5 seconds but the laboratory link is already visible and remains visible through 42.4 seconds; reduced return is settled and unobscured from 39.5 through 42.04 seconds. Sampled frames establish this visible continuity, not instrumented input-to-pixel latency or a complete flashing audit. Meaningful decoded frames from all six current desktop recordings show the same functional outcomes and conventional controls in both motion modes. Short normal compositing transitions settle into a readable destination; reduced mode retains static state clarity. Sampling establishes visible transitions, not full-speed frame pacing or a complete flashing audit.

continuity.observation: The Voyagewright shell, conventional Device connections return, anonymous sign-in destination, footer, and laboratory re-entry remain understandable around the local workspace. All six current return PNG artifacts share one exact raster with the complete re-entry link below the fixed header. Normal absolute samples 39.5 to 42.4 seconds and reduced absolute 39.5 to 42.04 seconds corroborate the repaired visible landing; relative and camera-fallback recordings corroborate their own returns. Resource cleanup and href/origin correctness are outside what pixels alone verify. Desktop return frames and all current returned PNGs retain the conventional device-connections destination, sign-in card, home/account shell and visible laboratory link. Capture continuity hashes additionally support the unchanged Voyagewright home origin. The original capture1 mobile occlusion is absent in current NORMAL and REDUCED PNGs and late recording frames, resolving that specific finding.

complexity.observation: Progressive disclosure keeps session diagnostics closed while current instructions, target plane, and primary actions stay prominent. Preparation offers an understandable two-mode choice with Relative movement recommended and Absolute pointing experimental. Guided demo controls are disclosed as simulation, and privacy/local-session statements sit below the task instead of adding prerequisites to the flow. Desktop uses progressive disclosure: camera/mode choice, target actions, independent metrics and then practice. Session diagnostics stays collapsed; separate guided-demo controls explicitly say simulation cannot prove physical accuracy. Three result rows remain subordinate to the next action.

role-outcomes.observation: For the captured anonymous mobile persona, natural device entry reaches a disclosed simulated hand; absolute setup requires nine training targets and a distinct five-target independent check before passing, then reaches practice and condition recovery. Relative control uses its own setup/check and explicitly describes moving the cursor from a comfortable reference. Normal relative playground is visible at 23.9/24.1 seconds, and reduced relative playground at 23.32 seconds, before conventional return. These are laboratory/demo outcomes and do not establish real-camera pointing accuracy or owner acceptance. For the sole contracted anonymous role, desktop media demonstrates natural entry without pairing, a disclosed demo, nine-point absolute setup followed by five held-out targets, separate relative cursor checking, practice, adverse framing guidance and conventional return. Detection is not presented as sufficient eligibility. No real-person webcam accuracy, authenticated role authority or owner PRODUCT_ACCEPTED is inferred.

fallbacks.observation: The camera-unavailable state explains The camera could not start in plain language and exposes both Retry live camera and Explore guided demo. Both motion-mode recordings subsequently show the camera-off guided demo gaining a ready hand, preserving conventional mode controls and an unobscured return. Recovery remains explicitly simulated and says camera accuracy is not measured. Desktop camera failure plainly says The camera could not start and exposes Retry live camera beside Explore guided demo. Recovery reaches the ready simulated hand while explicitly saying camera accuracy is not measured, then returns conventionally. Successful physical-camera retry and independent camera-resource cleanup are outside this bounded media evidence.

findings.observation: The complete Find the Hand interaction laboratory text now sits below the fixed Voyagewright header in the settled mobile return raster. Its underline and every letter are visible. The same raster is present for all six mobile journey/motion return artifacts. Current normal absolute return samples at 39.5, 40.5, 41.5, and 42.4 seconds retain the visible link; reduced absolute samples at 39.5, 40.5, 41.5, and 42.04 seconds provide the same visible outcome.
findings.contractBasis: Natural conventional return must restore the device-connections destination and its visible laboratory re-entry link while preserving readable mobile controls/contextual navigation.
findings.resolution: The current changed-source capture places the full laboratory re-entry link below the persistent header in the settled normal-mobile absolute return PNG and corroborating late recording frames; REDUCED and the other current mobile returns agree. I independently inspected the NORMAL 39.5/42.4 s and REDUCED 39.5/42.04 s decoded frames, in addition to the separate mobile review. Supporting exact-candidate hosted full-file regression evidence records a pass for a declaration checking untouched settled geometry/hit testing and later keyboard re-entry; actual selected case count is unavailable. The original persistent visual navigation occlusion is resolved within the supplied geometry. This does not establish real-camera accuracy, exhaustive keyboard semantics or owner acceptance.

reviews.reviewBoundary: Independent current capture2 rendered review. Capture1 review remains unchanged and blocked for its original evidence. Current acceptance is bounded to the supplied anonymous demo/fallback media and supporting regression evidence, not owner PRODUCT_ACCEPTED.
